label: ElevenLabs Transcribe (Realtime)
description: Realtime speech-to-text over a live audio stream (Scribe v2 realtime). Wire an audio Bus in (16-bit PCM chunks), and the transcript flows out on a text Bus as it is spoken, with the full transcript emitted at the end. The credential decision comes from a wired ElevenLabsAccess node.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The live audio stream: a bytes Bus of raw 16-bit PCM frames whose metadata declares the sample rate (an Audio Stream node produces exactly this).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node's output): whose key the session spends.

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: ISO language code of the audio (en, fr, ...). Empty lets the model detect it.

outputs.name: transcript
outputs.description: The live transcript: one Bus message of kind 'text' per committed speech segment, closed when the audio ends.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The full transcript, once the audio stream has ended.
